questions.q: In which year did the original Black Canary, Dinah Drake, debut in Flash Comics #86?
questions.why: Flash Comics #86 (August 1947) introduced Dinah Drake during comics' Golden Age.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created the original Black Canary?
questions.why: Writer Robert Kanigher and artist Carmine Infantino created her; O'Neil and Dillin later created her daughter Dinah Laurel.

questions.q: Dinah Laurel Lance, the second Black Canary, first appeared in which comic?
questions.why: Dennis O'Neil and Dick Dillin introduced Dinah Laurel in Justice League of America #75, published November 1969.

questions.q: What is the name of the sonic power that Dinah Laurel Lance unleashes by screaming?
questions.why: Her Canary Cry is an ultrasonic scream that can shatter objects, and she can also use it to glide by screaming downwards.

questions.q: Which archer is Black Canary's long-time romantic partner in the comics?
questions.why: Dinah Laurel meets Oliver Queen, Green Arrow, in the Justice League, and the two become a couple despite their age difference.

questions.q: In the comics' Birds of Prey, Black Canary works with Barbara Gordon under which hacker alias?
questions.why: After the Joker's attack, Barbara became Oracle, an info broker; she and Black Canary became close friends and Birds of Prey partners.

questions.q: Who played Dinah Lance in the 2020 DC film Birds of Prey?
questions.why: Jurnee Smollett played Dinah Lance, giving the character her big-screen debut in the DC Extended Universe.

questions.q: Which actress played Laurel Lance in the CW's 2012 vigilante-archer series?
questions.why: Katie Cassidy played Laurel Lance on Arrow, with Caity Lotz as her sister Sara Lance.

questions.q: What was Dinah Drake's civilian job in her Golden Age Black Canary feature?
questions.why: In Flash Comics, Dinah Drake ran a flower shop and was in love with Gotham police detective Larry Lance.

questions.q: In the 2024 comic series Black Canary: Best of the Best, she battles which rival for the title of top martial artist?
questions.why: The solo series pits Black Canary against Lady Shiva, a deadly martial artist, in a fight over who is the world's best.
